notes: Swiss standard VAT rate is 8.1%. Swiss dealer price lists and buyback pages were not reachable, so bar premiums, buyback and used-gold discounts are null. Commercial buyers of used precious metals must be registered with the federal Precious Metals Control Office since 2024 (about 360 registered); 18K is the usual jewellery standard.
